utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Mara, I heard from Eli that the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. Want to check the bulletin board with me to confirm the details?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, let's check it out. But I'm actually picking up the school calendar to plan the drive times—meeting Rosa at 10 tomorrow to sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, perfect—maybe we can meet up after you get the calendar? I'll swing by the board around 10:30.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik! We're organizing a repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Want to join?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, absolutely! I'm planning to set up the schedule this weekend, and Jules is helping spread the word on Maple Street and at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great to hear you're on board! Let me know if you need any help with the schedule or passing out flyers.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late. What's the latest on the repair drive schedule?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Ira said Vik's putting together the schedule this weekend, and Jules is spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks Gus. I still need to check with Rosa about the list before we set anything in stone.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Okay, I'll check with Quinn on the supply list before that meeting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the supply list! Yes, I should probably check if I need to bring anything. I hope I remember this time.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll remind you if you want. Just say the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I guess seeing is believing, but I'll believe it when I see it actually fix something.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's the laptop drive, Kira. Once we have the right parts, I'm confident it'll work.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You're confident, but where are these right parts coming from? I've heard promises before.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Cleo, are you free tomorrow at 10am for the repair drive planning meeting at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I should be free tomorrow at 10. I'll see you at the community center then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you then! I'll bring the school calendar.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does it start on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, it's Saturday at 10 AM, not Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought Rosa told me it was moved to Sunday. Are you sure it's Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm still worried about parking, though. Did anyone check if there's enough space?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Not sure, but maybe we can figure it out at tomorrow's meeting at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Tomorrow's meeting? I thought it was this evening. We really need to be on the same page about that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey, I was just thinking—should we start rounding up tools while we wait for Dane and Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, good idea! Gus already offered to help with tools, so let's see what we've got between us.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, let's grab our stuff and meet in my driveway—I've got a decent set of wrenches and a power drill.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I've been thinking about the repair drive, hope the parking and scheduling are sorted.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I'm meeting Faye at the community center at 10 to sort it all out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That's good to hear, I'm glad someone's taking charge of the details.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Uli, good timing! We're meeting tomorrow at the community center at 10 to plan the laptop repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I see... I'm not sure I'll be able to make it, but I hope it goes well.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That's a shame, Uli. If you change your mind, let me know—we could use your help sorting the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Rosa! Did you hear about the repair drive on Sunday? We're meeting at the community center at 10 to fix up the neighborhood. You should come!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I've been coordinating it! We even got the overflow lot for parking, so it should be smooth. See you there at 10!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Wow, Rosa, you're the organizer? That's awesome! And the overflow lot is a great idea—I was worried about parking.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Vik, I'm heading to the community center to check the bulletin board for the repair drive supply list. Want to come along?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure! Jules is already helping spread the word about the repair drive at the community center, so maybe we'll see some flyers up!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, that's great—maybe Jules already has the details posted. Let's head over and check it out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Nell, did I miss anything important about the laptop repair drive meeting tomorrow?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Actually, it's this Saturday, not tomorrow. I heard it's at the community center. Want to check the bulletin board with me?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday? I thought it was tomorrow. Yeah, let's go check the bulletin board—I don't want to miss it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, still on for the drive—just waiting on Gus's list to know which one.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll check with Quinn; maybe he has Gus's list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Good idea, let me know what Quinn says.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Vik's got the schedule sorted, so we just need the list from Rosa to kick things off.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Ah, good. So we're all set for 10 at the community center then?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, that's the plan — just waiting on Rosa's list to see who's bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, have you heard about the repair drive? Vik's getting a schedule together this weekend, and Jules is spreading the word—it's really coming together.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Ira, which repair drive do you mean—the server one or the laptop one?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: The neighborhood fix-it thing—you know, to get broken stuff around here working again. Vik's got a plan, and Jules is helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina! We're meeting at the community center tomorrow at 10am to plan the repair drive. Can you make it?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought the repair drive is Sunday, not tomorrow. Are you sure about the date?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, the drive itself is Sunday, but we're meeting tomorrow to plan it out. I'm bringing the school calendar to help coordinate.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Alright, I'll swing by Rosa's place now to grab that list.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, while you're at Rosa's, remind her about the repair drive meeting tomorrow at 10.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I'll make sure to tell her. See you tomorrow at 10.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I heard about the repair drive. Need me to bring over my tool kit?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You actually believe that drive is gonna work? I've seen too many of these things go nowhere.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I get your skepticism, Kira, but I'd rather try and see. If nothing else, it's a chance to help some folks out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules! We're organizing a repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. Want to join us?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds great, Quinn! I've actually been helping Vik coordinate the schedule for that—I'd love to join.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Awesome, Jules! We could use your help with coordination. See you Saturday at 10!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Tess, I'm picking up the school calendar tomorrow so we can plan the repair drive times—want to help?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure, I'd love to help! I'm so excited for the repair drive this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great! We're meeting at Rosa's place at 10 tomorrow to plan—you should join us!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, hello! Are we still on for that repair drive this weekend? I hope I'm not mixing it up with something else.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, Oren! It's this Sunday at the community center, and they've opened up the overflow lot for parking, so no worries there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Sunday? Right, right! I'm glad they sorted the parking—I was worried I'd have to park on the lawn again.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I just hope they've got the parking sorted out for this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, parking's always a hassle around here. I guess we'll see.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I guess we'll just have to wait and see how it goes.
